nodes.name: Supabase - Store Result
nodes.notes: Auth: Header Auth credential with TWO headers needed - 'apikey' = your Supabase anon/service key, and 'Authorization' = 'Bearer YOUR_SUPABASE_KEY'. Replace YOUR_PROJECT_REF in the URL with your actual Supabase project reference.

nodes.name: Google Docs - Create Report
nodes.notes: Requires Google OAuth2 credential - connect your Google account in n8n (free, no card needed). This creates a new Doc; a follow-up 'Update' call inserts report_markdown as the body text.

parameters.text: ={{ "Wayfind found " + $('Keep Only MATCH / UNCLEAR').all().length + " potential match(es) today. Check the Doc: " + $json.documentUrl }}

nodes.name: Slack - Send Notification
nodes.notes: Requires Slack OAuth2 credential (free) - create a simple Slack app or use n8n's built-in Slack connection. Set YOUR_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID to your actual channel.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ { "model": "gpt-4o-mini", "messages": [ { "role": "user", "content": "You are screening a job posting for this candidate: Haider Ali, self-taught GenAI/full-stack engineer, Sialkot Pakistan, ~1 year experience. HARD EXCLUSIONS: no Python-core roles, no Flutter/Dart, no hard degree requirement, must be worldwide-remote OR Pakistan-based (reject US-only/EU-only/India-only), no Senior/Staff/Lead/Principal titles or 3+ years required roles.
